description: Reverses a create_nodes run from the ledger: deletes the nodes it created and moves every node it overwrote back to its earlier coordinates. Refuses while elements, structure groups or supports use the nodes it created (undo those first). Default: the latest create_nodes run not yet undone. Previews unless apply: true.

runId.description: Ledger run id; default = the latest create_nodes run not yet undone.

name: create_nodes_undo
title: Undo a create_nodes run
